# Film grain

Photographic grain: fine noise that sits mostly in shadows and midtones and changes at a film frame rate. With motion off it holds a single grain pattern.

<EffectDemo effect="film-grain" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { filmGrain } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/film-grain';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(filmGrain({ preset: 'fine' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 0.12`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter           | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                                  |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `intensity`         | number  | `0.12`  | 0 – 0.6    | Strength of the grain.                                       |
| `size`              | number  | `1.5`   | 1 – 6 px   | Size of a grain particle.                                    |
| `luminanceResponse` | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 1      | How much less grain shows in highlights, as with film stock. |
| `colored`           | boolean | `false` |            | Separate grain per color channel, like color negative film.  |
| `animated`          | boolean | `true`  |            | Change the grain every frame.                                |
| `speed`             | number  | `24`    | 1 – 60 fps | How often the grain changes.                                 |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fine`    | `intensity: 0.07`, `size: 1`                            |
| `stock35` | `intensity: 0.14`, `size: 1.6`                          |
| `heavy`   | `intensity: 0.3`, `size: 2.6`, `luminanceResponse: 0.3` |
| `color`   | `colored: true`, `intensity: 0.16`                      |

Apply one with `filmGrain({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/film-grain`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Two-uniform approximation of Gaussian grain with a luminance response, after film stock grain curves.
